SELECT w.id, w.code, w.source, w.status, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, u.name AS unitName, w.planned_qty AS plannedQty, w.create_time AS createTime FROM workorder w LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = w.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = m.unit_id
AND w.code LIKE #{filter.workorderCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND m.code LIKE #{filter.productCodePattern} ESCAPE '!'
AND w.status != #{cancelledStatus} AND w.status = #{filter.status}
ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId, SUM(c.accepted_qty) AS quantity, COUNT(c.id) AS factCount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.execution_code) AS executionCount, SUM(CASE WHEN c.accepted_qty IS NULL OR c.accepted_qty < 0 OR c.accepted_qty != c.effective_qty THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalidCount, MAX(c.recorded_at) AS lastCompletedAt FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_execution_completion c ON c.execution_code = e.execution_code WHERE e.status = #{fullyReceived} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_execution_completion newer WHERE newer.execution_code=c.execution_code AND (newer.recorded_at>c.recorded_at OR (newer.recorded_at=c.recorded_at AND newer.id>c.id))) AND e.workorder_id IN #{id} GROUP BY e.workorder_id

SELECT e.workorder_id AS workorderId,d.id AS declarationRowId,d.declaration_id AS declarationId, d.revision_no AS revision,d.execution_code AS executionCode,d.affected_node_id AS routingNodeId, d.defect_qty AS defectQty,d.record_action AS recordAction,e.status AS executionStatus FROM mes_production_execution e JOIN mes_production_defect d ON d.execution_code=e.execution_code WHERE e.workorder_id IN #{id} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_production_defect newer WHERE newer.declaration_id=d.declaration_id AND newer.revision_no>d.revision_no) ORDER BY d.id
